extracted.name: Three Corn Casserole
extracted.description: This mixture of creamed corn, corn kernels, and corn bread mix with sour cream and butter makes a delicious side dish for meat or poultry.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
In a mixing bowl, stir together the sour cream, butter, creamed corn, corn niblets, and corn muffin mix.
Pour into a casserole dish or 9-inch baking dish. Bake in preheated oven for 40 minutes or until set.
